headline: Charleston close out the conference schedule on top
dek: Charleston's win at Frostburg State, their seventh in a row, leaves them on thirty-six points with no match left to play. Concord and Davis & Elkins also won on the night and sit three and four points back; Davis & Elkins handed Charleston their only conference defeat.
displaced_by: Charleston beat Frostburg State and completed their schedule on thirty-six points, so the standing dek's 'one match each to play' no longer holds.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Charleston have scored more goals than West Liberty and Wheeling together, and sixteen different players have shared their fifty-one; the scoring is spread, not carried.

wire.line: Davis & Elkins have lost only once all season, and no other conference side has beaten Charleston.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Concord have conceded ten goals in seventeen matches and won twelve of them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Martin Echarren has ten goals and three assists for Charleston from thirty-five shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Frank Stare has seven goals and five assists for Frostburg State from thirty-two shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Shai'ya Fitzgerald has made sixty-four saves for West Liberty and conceded sixteen goals.

last_match.line: Charleston have won every match away from home, and handed Frostburg State their first home defeat of the season.

next_match.line: Concord have lost at home only to Charleston, and Point Park have already been beaten there this season.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
